Akinbule oluwafemi olamilekan (born on April 5, 2006) known professionally as King Flekky is a Nigerian Singer-songwriter who get widespread recognize after release Holiday in 2022 he went viral in all social media and music platforms.
Biography
King flekky was born and brought up in okitipupa  before coming to Ado Ekiti in 2022, king flekky had his primary education at Methodist primary school and Igodan lisa Okunmo high school for his secondary education.
King flekky started his music career at the age of 11 years old he was started with posting his video recording without showing face, and be using phone applications studio.

Akinbule oluwafemi know professional as King Flekky is a Nigerian singer-songwriter born on (05 April 2006) he get popular well known after his single track named Time no dey in 2024.
Biography
King Flekky grew up in okitipupa, where he found his musical talent and pursued a career as a musician. Flekky nailed his sound, establishing himself among the performers to watch, with inspiration from the graeti Star never dawn group. He started his music career at the age of 7 years old and he started with phone record and he use the phone record to release his first release name Holiday and the track went viral in all social media that make everyone loves him and support him. King Flekky started with street freestyle and give love vibes to his family and street ones that make everyone started posting him to Facebook and Instagram when there getting likes and follower with Flekky's freestyle that why they are help him and showing him love.
